title: Server-held Staging Activation Gateway provider authority transport

phases.objective: Provide a server-held secret-file transport and explicit fail-closed feature gate for the Staging Activation Gateway while proving the shared adapter does not enable or mutate Production.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Evaluate the Activation Gateway rollout plan with the provider credential absent, present through a server-held secret, and apply disabled by default.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Staging can resolve provider authority only from the server-held secret-file transport; missing authority fails closed; Production remains non-mutating and separately bound.
steps: Keep the provider token out of .env.staging and mount only the server-held Docker secret into the Staging app.
Default STAGING_ACTIVATION_GATEWAY_APPLY_ENABLED to false and require an explicit typed local provisioning step before enabling it.
Resolve the fixed Staging Worker resource binding without caller-selected account, script, resource, DNS or custom-domain targets.
Copy a legacy Staging tunnel token into the isolated Staging ProgramData namespace only when the canonical file is missing, without deleting the legacy file.
Require live Staging certification after deployment; do not authorize or perform a Production deployment from this change.
assertions: No Cloudflare provider credential value is committed, returned or persisted in .env.staging.
Missing or unreadable server-held provider authority blocks before a provider call.
The feature gate remains false by default and cannot use the empty placeholder secret for apply.
The shared adapter delegates only the Staging profile path changed here; Production rollout implementation and Production resource binding are unchanged.
No database migration, DNS mutation, custom-domain mutation, provider mutation or Production deployment is performed by this PR.
